title.en: Unit 1: Smoking, Sleep and the Seerah
Intensive reading: The harms of smoking

intro.en: In this lesson you read an article about the harms of smoking, told through a neighbourhood pharmacist. It shows the harm to the smoker, to the people around him, and to his money, and it quotes a Qur'an verse and a hadith. Read each sentence slowly.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mohalle ke ek dawa-saaz ke zariye tamakhnoshi ke nuqsanat par mazmoon parhenge. Is mein smoker ka, uske aas paas walon ka aur maal ka nuqsan bayan hota hai, aur Quran ki ek aayat aur ek Hadees bhi hai. Har jumla aahista parhein.
intro.ar: في هٰذا الدَّرْسِ تَقْرَأُ مَقالاً عَنْ أَضْرارِ التَّدْخينِ عَلى لِسانِ صَيْدَلِيٍّ في الحَيِّ، وَفيهِ ضَرَرُ التَّدْخينِ عَلى المُدَخِّنِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ وَعَلى مالِهِ، وَفيهِ آيَةٌ وَحَديثٌ. اقْرَأْ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ.

dialogue.ar: في الحَيِّ الَّذي أَسْكُنُ فيهِ صَيْدَلِيَّةٌ قَديمَةٌ، وَيَقولُ صاحِبُها: أَكْثَرُ ما يُحْزِنُني أَنْ أَرى المُدَخِّنينَ يَشْتَرونَ السَّجائِرَ ثُمَّ يَشْتَرونَ الدَّواءَ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ḥayyi l-dhī askunu fīhi ṣaydaliyyatun qadīmat, wa yaqūlu ṣāḥibuhā: aktharu mā yuḥzinunī an arā l-mudakhkhinīna yashtarūna s-sajāʾira thumma yashtarūna d-dawāʾ.
dialogue.en: In the neighbourhood where I live there is an old pharmacy, and its owner says: what saddens me most is to see smokers buy cigarettes and then buy medicine.
dialogue.ur: Mere mohalle mein ek purani dawakhana hai, uska malik kehta hai: mujhe sab se zyada dukh is baat ka hai ke smokers pehle cigarette khareedte hain phir dawa.

dialogue.ar: كانَ التَّدْخينُ في الماضي عادَةً قَليلَةً، أَمّا اليَوْمَ فَقَدْ صارَ وَباءً يَنْتَشِرُ بَيْنَ الصِّغارِ وَالكِبار.
dialogue.tr: kāna t-tadkhīnu fī l-māḍī ʿādatan qalīlatan, ammā l-yawma fa-qad ṣāra wabāʾan yantashiru bayna ṣ-ṣighāri wa l-kibār.
dialogue.en: Smoking used to be a rare habit in the past, but today it has become an epidemic spreading among young and old.
dialogue.ur: Pehle tamakhnoshi kam logon ki aadat thi, magar aaj yeh ek wabaa ban gayi hai jo bachon aur baron mein phail rahi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَكْفي أَنْ نَعْرِفَ أَنَّ المُدَخِّنَ يَسْتَنْشِقُ مَعَ كُلِّ نَفَسٍ مَوادَّ سامَّةً تُهاجِمُ جِسْمَهُ مِنَ الدّاخِل.
dialogue.tr: wa yakfī an naʿrifa anna l-mudakhkhina yastanshiqu maʿa kulli nafasin mawādda sāmmatan tuhājimu jismahu mina d-dākhil.
dialogue.en: It is enough to know that with every breath the smoker inhales poisonous substances that attack his body from the inside.
dialogue.ur: Itna jaan lena kaafi hai ke smoker har saans ke saath zehreeli cheezein andar khinchta hai jo uske jism par andar se hamla karti hain.

dialogue.ar: فَهُوَ يُعَرِّضُ نَفْسَهُ لِسَرَطانِ الرِّئَةِ وَالِالْتِهاباتِ المُزْمِنَةِ وَأَمْراضِ القَلْب، وَتَرْتَفِعُ بَيْنَ المُدَخِّنينَ نِسْبَةُ الوَفَيات.
dialogue.tr: fa-huwa yuʿarriḍu nafsahu li-saraṭāni r-riʾati wa l-ltihābāti l-muzminati wa amrāḍi l-qalb, wa tartafiʿu bayna l-mudakhkhinīna nisbatu l-wafayāt.
dialogue.en: So he exposes himself to lung cancer, chronic inflammations and heart disease, and the rate of deaths rises among smokers.
dialogue.ur: Is tarah woh apne aap ko phephron ke cancer, purani soozishon aur dil ki bimariyon ke samne kar deta hai, aur smokers mein maut ki sharah barh jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَضْرارِهِ أَيْضاً أَنَّهُ يُسَرِّعُ الشَّيْخوخَةَ، فَيَبْدو المُدَخِّنُ الشّابُّ كَأَنَّهُ في الخَمْسينَ مِنْ عُمُرِه.
dialogue.tr: wa min aḍrārihi ayḍn annahu yusarriʿu sh-shaykhūkhat, fa-yabdū l-mudakhkhinu sh-shābbu kaʾannahu fī l-khamsīna min ʿumurih.
dialogue.en: Among its harms also is that it hastens old age, so the young smoker looks as if he were fifty.
dialogue.ur: Iske nuqsanat mein se yeh bhi hai ke yeh budhape ko jaldi le aata hai, to jawan smoker aisa lagta hai goya woh pachaas saal ka ho.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ حَذَّرَ الأَطِبّاءُ مِنْ أَنَّ الدُّخانَ المُتَصاعِدَ مِنَ السِّيجارَةِ يُؤْذي مَنْ يَجْلِسُ قَريباً مِنْ صاحِبِها.
dialogue.tr: wa qad ḥadhdhara l-aṭibbāʾu min anna d-dukhāna l-mutaṣāʿida mina s-siījārati yuʾdhī man yajlisu qarībn min ṣāḥibihā.
dialogue.en: Doctors have warned that the smoke rising from a cigarette harms whoever sits close to its owner.
dialogue.ur: Doctoron ne khabardar kiya hai ke cigarette se uthta hua dhuan us shakhs ko bhi takleef deta hai jo smoker ke qareeb baithta hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالتَّدْخينُ ضَرَرٌ مُتَعَدٍّ، لا يَقِفُ عِنْدَ صاحِبِهِ، بَلْ يَصِلُ إِلَى الأَطْفالِ وَإِلَى الأُمِّ الحامِل.
dialogue.tr: fa-t-tadkhīnu ḍararun mutaʿadd, lā yaqifu ʿinda ṣāḥibih, bal yaṣilu ilā l-aṭfāli wa ilā l-ummi l-ḥāmil.
dialogue.en: Smoking is a harm that reaches others; it does not stop at its owner but reaches the children and the pregnant mother.
dialogue.ur: Tamakhnoshi aisa nuqsan hai jo doosron tak pohanchta hai; yeh smoker par nahi rukta balke bachon aur haamila maa tak jata hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالحامِلُ الَّتي تَتَنَفَّسُ الدُّخانَ قَدْ تَلِدُ طِفْلاً ضَعيفَ الجِسْمِ، وَهٰذِهِ مُصيبَةٌ كُبْرى لِلأُسْرَةِ كُلِّها.
dialogue.tr: fa-l-ḥāmilu l-tī tatanaffasu d-dukhāna qad talidu ṭifln ḍaʿīfa l-jism, wa hādhihi muṣībatun kubrā li-l-usrati kullihā.
dialogue.en: A pregnant woman who breathes smoke may give birth to a weak child, and this is a great calamity for the whole family.
dialogue.ur: Jo haamila aurat dhuan mein saans leti hai woh kamzor bacha jan sakti hai, aur yeh poore khandan ke liye bari museebat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُسْلِمُ يَتَذَكَّرُ قَوْلَ رَبِّهِ: ﴿وَلَا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ﴾.
dialogue.tr: wa l-muslimu yatadhakkaru qawla rabbih: «wa lā tulqū bi-aydīkum ilā t-tahlukat.»
dialogue.en: A Muslim remembers the word of his Lord: «Do not throw yourselves into destruction.»
dialogue.ur: Musalman apne Rab ka farman yaad rakhta hai: «Apne haathon khud ko halaakat mein na daalo.»

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَ في الحَديثِ الشَّريفِ: «لا ضَرَرَ وَلا ضِرارَ».
dialogue.tr: wa jāʾa fī l-ḥadīthi sh-sharīf: «lā ḍarara wa lā ḍirār.»
dialogue.en: And in the noble hadith: «There is to be no harm and no returning of harm.»
dialogue.ur: Aur Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai: «Na khud nuqsan uthao, na kisi ko nuqsan pohanchao.»

dialogue.ar: وَالمُدَخِّنُ يُنْفِقُ مِنْ راتِبِهِ كُلَّ شَهْرٍ مَبْلَغاً كَبيراً، وَهٰذا مِنْ إِضاعَةِ المالِ، لِأَنَّهُ يَشْتَري بِهِ المَرَضَ.
dialogue.tr: wa l-mudakhkhinu yunfiqu min rātibihi kulla shahrin mablaghn kabīrn, wa hādhā min iḍāʿati l-māl, li-annahu yashtarī bihi l-maraḍ.
dialogue.en: The smoker spends a large sum of his salary every month, and this is wasting money, because he buys illness with it.
dialogue.ur: Smoker har mahine apni tankhwah ka bara hissa kharch karta hai, aur yeh maal zaya karna hai, kyunke woh us se bimari khareedta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ الخَسارَةِ أَيْضاً الوَقْتُ الَّذي يَضيعُ في المُسْتَشْفَياتِ، وَالأَيّامُ الَّتي يَغيبُ فيها عَنْ عَمَلِه.
dialogue.tr: wa mina l-khasārati ayḍn l-waqtu l-dhī yaḍīʿu fī l-mustashfayāt, wa l-ayyāmu l-tī yaghību fīhā ʿan ʿamalih.
dialogue.en: Another loss is the time that is wasted in hospitals and the days on which he is absent from his work.
dialogue.ur: Ek aur ghata woh waqt hai jo aspatalon mein zaya hota hai aur woh din jin mein woh apne kaam se gair haazir rehta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولُ بَعْضُ الأَطِبّاءِ: مَنْ يُدَخِّنُ كَأَنَّهُ يُشْعِلُ النّارَ في عُمُرِهِ، وَيَمْشي نَحْوَ الِانْتِحارِ بِخُطًى هادِئَة.
dialogue.tr: wa yaqūlu baʿḍu l-aṭibbāʾ: man yudakhkhinu kaʾannahu yushʿilu n-nāra fī ʿumurih, wa yamshī naḥwa l-ntiḥāri bi-khuṭanā hādiʾa.
dialogue.en: Some doctors say: whoever smokes is as if he sets fire to his own life, and walks towards suicide with quiet steps.
dialogue.ur: Kuch doctor kehte hain: jo smoking karta hai goya woh apni umr mein aag lagata hai aur khudkushi ki taraf aahista qadmon se chalta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ رَبُّنا في وَصْفِ رَسولِهِ ﷺ: ﴿وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبَائِثَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: wa qāla rabbunā fī waṣfi rasūlihi ﷺ: «wa yuḥillu lahumu ṭ-ṭayyibāti wa yuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu l-khabāʾith.»
dialogue.en: Our Lord said, describing His Messenger ﷺ: «He makes lawful for them the good things and forbids for them the bad things.»
dialogue.ur: Hamare Rab ne apne Rasool ﷺ ki sifat mein farmaya: «Woh unke liye pakeezah cheezein halal karta hai aur napak cheezein un par haram karta hai.»

vocab.ur: aisa nuqsan jo doosron tak pohanche

q.en: According to the text, which is a disease caused by smoking?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq tamakhnoshi se kaun si bimari hoti hai?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ، أَيُّ مَرَضٍ يُسَبِّبُهُ التَّدْخينُ؟

q.en: What does «ضَرَرٌ مُتَعَدٍّ» mean?
q.ur: «ضَرَرٌ مُتَعَدٍّ» ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: According to the text, who besides the smoker can be harmed by cigarette smoke?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq smoker ke ilawa cigarette ke dhuein se kis ko nuqsan ho sakta hai?
q.ar: مَنْ يَتَضَرَّرُ بِدُخانِ السِّيجارَةِ غَيْرَ المُدَخِّنِ، حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: According to the text, what does the smoker buy with his salary?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq smoker apni tankhwah se kya khareedta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَشْتَري المُدَخِّنُ بِراتِبِهِ، حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is the meaning of «الوَباء»?
q.ur: «الوَباء» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Normally a doer-word like «سابِق» (one who is ahead) is on the pattern فاعِل. To say someone does it a LOT, Arabic changes the pattern: «سَبّاق» (always far ahead) is on فَعّال. Other intensive patterns are مِفْعال (مِقْوال), فَعول (حَسود), فَعيل (سَميع) and فَعِل (فَرِح).
intro.ur: Aam taur par «سابِق» (aage hone wala) fa'il ke wazan par hota hai. Jab kisi kaam ko bohat zyada karne wale ko batana ho to Arabic wazan badal deti hai: «سَبّاق» (hamesha aage rehne wala) فَعّال ke wazan par hai. Doosre mubalaghe ke wazan: مِفْعال (مِقْوال)، فَعول (حَسود)، فَعيل (سَميع) aur فَعِل (فَرِح).
intro.ar: الأَصْلُ في اسْمِ الفاعِلِ أَنْ يَكونَ عَلى وَزْنِ فاعِل مِثْلَ «سابِق». وَلِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى الكَثْرَةِ تَتَغَيَّرُ الصّيغَةُ فَتَصيرُ «سَبّاق» عَلى وَزْنِ فَعّال. وَمِنْ صِيَغِ المُبالَغَةِ أَيْضاً مِفْعال، فَعول، فَعيل، فَعِل.

dialogue.ar: الجَدُّ ضاحِكٌ مَعَ أَحْفادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-jaddu ḍāḥikun maʿa aḥfādih.
dialogue.en: The grandfather laughs with his grandchildren. (normal form)
dialogue.ur: Dada apne potay-potiyon ke saath hansne wala hai. (aam sheklon)

dialogue.ar: الجَدُّ ضَحّاكٌ مَعَ أَحْفادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-jaddu ḍaḥḥākun maʿa aḥfādih.
dialogue.en: The grandfather is always laughing with his grandchildren. (intensive, فَعّال)
dialogue.ur: Dada apne potay-potiyon ke saath bohat hansne wale hain. (mubalagha, fa'aal)

dialogue.ar: الغَنِيُّ مُعْطٍ لِلْفُقَراءِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ghaniyyu muʿṭin li-l-fuqarāʾ.
dialogue.en: The rich man gives to the poor. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Ameer aadmi gareebon ko deta hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: الغَنِيُّ مِعْطاءٌ لِلْفُقَراءِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ghaniyyu miʿṭāʾun li-l-fuqarāʾ.
dialogue.en: The rich man gives very generously to the poor. (intensive, مِفْعال)
dialogue.ur: Ameer aadmi gareebon ko bohat deta hai. (mubalagha, mif'aal)

dialogue.ar: المَريضُ شاكِرٌ لِطَبيبِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-marīḍu shākirun li-ṭabībih.
dialogue.en: The patient is thankful to his doctor. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Mareez apne doctor ka shukr guzar hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: المَريضُ شَكورٌ لِطَبيبِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-marīḍu shakūrun li-ṭabībih.
dialogue.en: The patient is very thankful to his doctor. (intensive, فَعول)
dialogue.ur: Mareez apne doctor ka bohat shukr guzar hai. (mubalagha, fa'ool)

dialogue.ar: الأُسْتاذُ عالِمٌ بِالنَّحْوِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ustādhu ʿālimun bi-n-naḥw.
dialogue.en: The teacher knows grammar. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Ustaad nahw jaanta hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: الأُسْتاذُ عَليمٌ بِالنَّحْوِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ustādhu ʿalīmun bi-n-naḥw.
dialogue.en: The teacher knows grammar very well. (intensive, فَعيل)
dialogue.ur: Ustaad nahw ko bohat achhi tarah jaanta hai. (mubalagha, fa'eel)

dialogue.ar: الطِّفْلُ حاذِرٌ مِنَ النّارِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭiflu ḥādhirun mina n-nār.
dialogue.en: The child is careful of the fire. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Bacha aag se bachne wala hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: الطِّفْلُ حَذِرٌ مِنَ النّارِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭiflu ḥadhirun mina n-nār.
dialogue.en: The child is very wary of the fire. (intensive, فَعِل)
dialogue.ur: Bacha aag se bohat chaukanna rehta hai. (mubalagha, fa'il)

q.en: Which word is an intensive form of «سابِق»?
q.ur: «سابِق» ka mubalaghe wala seegha kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ صيغَةُ مُبالَغَةٍ مِنْ «سابِق»؟

q.en: What does the intensive form (sīghat al-mubālagha) express?
q.ur: Seeghat-ul-mubalagha kya batata hai?

options: Doing something a lot or very strongly

q.en: Which pattern is «مِقْوال» on?
q.ur: «مِقْوال» kis wazan par hai?

q.en: «حَسود» is on the pattern:
q.ur: «حَسود» kis wazan par hai?

q.en: What does «طَمّاع» mean?
q.ur: «طَمّاع» ka matlab?

intro.en: Here you practise listening to two talks about sleep: tips for healthy sleep, and advice for people who have sleep problems. Listen first, then answer true-or-false and multiple-choice questions. Below are the main ideas and words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein neend ke baare mein do guftgu sun kar mashq karte hain: sehatmand neend ke mashwaray aur un logon ke liye nasihat jinhein neend ki mushkil ho. Pehle suniye, phir sahi/ghalat aur multiple-choice sawalat hal kijiye. Neeche ahem khayalat aur alfaz hain.
intro.ar: في هٰذا الدَّرْسِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الِاسْتِماعِ إِلى حَديثَيْنِ عَنِ النَّوْمِ: نَصائِحُ لِنَوْمٍ صِحِّيٍّ، وَإِرْشاداتٌ لِمَنْ يُعاني مَشاكِلَ في النَّوْمِ. اسْتَمِعْ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ أَجِبْ، وَتَجِدُ هُنا الأَفْكارَ وَالكَلِماتِ الرَّئيسَةَ.

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ العَميقُ مِنْ أَجْمَلِ نِعَمِ اللهِ عَلَيْنا، وَلٰكِنَّ كَثيراً مِنَ النّاسِ يَشْكونَ مِنَ الأَرَقِ وَصُعوبَةِ النَّوْم.
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu l-ʿamīqu min ajmali niʿami llāhi ʿalaynā, wa lākinna kathīrn mina n-nāsi yashkūna mina l-araqi wa ṣuʿūbati n-nawm.
dialogue.en: Deep sleep is one of the most beautiful blessings of Allah upon us, but many people complain of insomnia and difficulty sleeping.
dialogue.ur: Gehri neend Allah ki sab se khoobsurat naimaton mein se hai, lekin bohat se log be-khwabi aur neend ki mushkil ki shikayat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ الإِنْسانُ البالِغُ إِلى سَبْعِ ساعاتٍ أَوْ تِسْعٍ مِنَ النَّوْمِ لِيَسْتَعيدَ نَشاطَهُ في الصَّباح.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju l-insānu l-bālighu ilā sabʿi sāʿātin aw tisʿin mina n-nawmi li-yastaʿīda nashāṭahu fī ṣ-ṣabāḥ.
dialogue.en: A grown person needs seven or nine hours of sleep to regain his energy in the morning.
dialogue.ur: Baalig insaan ko subah apni taqat wapas paane ke liye saat se nau ghante ki neend chahiye.

dialogue.ar: لا تَذْهَبْ إِلَى السَّريرِ حَتّى يَأْتِيَكَ النُّعاسُ، وَاجْلِسْ في مَكانٍ هادِئٍ تَقْرَأُ فيهِ قَليلاً.
dialogue.tr: lā tadhhab ilā s-sarīri ḥattā yaʾtiyaka n-nuʿās, wa jlis fī makānin hādiʾin taqraʾu fīhi qalīln.
dialogue.en: Do not go to bed until sleepiness comes to you, and sit in a quiet place where you read a little.
dialogue.ur: Bistar par us waqt tak na jayein jab tak neend na aaye, aur kisi khamosh jagah baith kar thora sa parh lein.

dialogue.ar: وَتَجَنَّبِ العَشاءَ الثَّقيلَ في اللَّيْل، فَهُوَ يَجْعَلُ نَوْمَكَ مُتَقَطِّعاً.
dialogue.tr: wa tajannabi l-ʿashāʾa th-thaqīla fī l-layl, fa-huwa yajʿalu nawmaka mutaqaṭṭiʿn.
dialogue.en: And avoid a heavy dinner at night, for it makes your sleep broken.
dialogue.ur: Raat ko bhaari khana khane se bachein, kyunke yeh aap ki neend ko toot-toot kar aane wali bana deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَحاوِلْ أَلّا تَرْبِطَ سَريرَكَ بِالعَمَلِ أَوِ الهاتِفِ؛ فَالسَّريرُ لِلنَّوْمِ فَقَط.
dialogue.tr: wa ḥāwil allā tarbiṭa sarīraka bi-l-ʿamali awi l-hātif; fa-s-sarīru li-n-nawmi faqaṭ.
dialogue.en: And try not to link your bed with work or the phone; the bed is for sleep only.
dialogue.ur: Koshish karein ke apne bistar ko kaam ya phone se na jodein; bistar sirf sone ke liye hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا مَنْ تَشْغَلُهُ الهُمومُ النَّفْسِيَّةُ فَلْيَقْرَأْ وِرْداً مِنَ الأَذْكارِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، وَلْيُمارِسْ بَعْضَ تَمارينِ الِاسْتِرْخاء.
dialogue.tr: ammā man tashghaluhu l-humūmu n-nafsiyyatu fa-lyaqraʾ wirdn mina l-adhkāri qabla n-nawm, wa lyumāris baʿḍa tamārīni l-stirkhāʾ.
dialogue.en: As for someone occupied by psychological worries, let him read a daily portion of remembrance before sleep and do some relaxation exercises.
dialogue.ur: Jis ko zehni fikrein pareshan karti hon woh sone se pehle azkaar ka koi wird parhe aur aaram dene wali kuch warzishein kare.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَكونُ سَبَبُ الأَرَقِ مَرَضاً عُضْوِيّاً، وَعِنْدَئِذٍ يَجِبُ أَنْ يَزورَ المَريضُ الطَّبيب.
dialogue.tr: wa qad yakūnu sababu l-araqi maraḍn ʿuḍwiyyn, wa ʿindaʾidhin yajibu an yazūra l-marīḍu ṭ-ṭabīb.
dialogue.en: The cause of insomnia may be a physical illness, and then the patient must visit the doctor.
dialogue.ur: Be-khwabi ki wajah koi jismani bimari bhi ho sakti hai, aur tab mareez ko doctor ke paas jana chahiye.

intro.en: This lesson explains what a debate (munāẓara) is and gives rules for a good discussion: listen fully, respect others, argue with proof, and look only for the truth.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein munazara kya hota hai aur achhi guftgu ke usool bayan kiye gaye hain: poori tarah sunna, doosron ka ehtiram, daleel se baat karna aur sirf haq ki talash.
intro.ar: يُعَرِّفُ هٰذا الدَّرْسُ بِالمُناظَرَةِ وَيَذْكُرُ آدابَ الحِوارِ الجَيِّدِ: الِاسْتِماعُ الكامِلُ، وَاحْتِرامُ الآخَرينَ، وَالِاحْتِجاجُ بِالدَّليلِ، وَطَلَبُ الحَقِّ وَحْدَهُ.

dialogue.ar: المُناظَرَةُ حِوارٌ مُنَظَّمٌ بَيْنَ شَخْصَيْنِ أَوْ فَريقَيْنِ، يَعْرِضُ كُلٌّ مِنْهُما وُجْهَةَ نَظَرِهِ مُدَعَّمَةً بِالأَدِلَّة.
dialogue.tr: al-munāẓaratu ḥiūrun munaẓẓamun bayna shakhṣayni aw fa-rīqayn, yaʿriḍu kullun minhumā wujhata naẓarihi mudaʿʿamatan bi-l-adilla.
dialogue.en: A debate is an organised dialogue between two people or two teams, each presenting his point of view supported by proofs.
dialogue.ur: Munazara do shakhson ya do giroohon ke beech munazzam baat-cheet hai, jis mein har ek apna nuqta-e-nazar daleelon ke saath pesh karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ تُعَلِّمُنا كَيْفَ نُدافِعُ عَنْ آرائِنا المُتَبايِنَةِ بِهُدوءٍ لا بِالصُّراخ.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya tuʿallimunā kayfa nudāfiʿu ʿan ʾārāʾinā l-mutabāyinati bi-hudūʾin lā bi-ṣ-ṣurākh.
dialogue.en: It teaches us how to defend our differing opinions calmly, not by shouting.
dialogue.ur: Yeh humein sikhati hai ke apni mukhtalif raaon ka difa sukoon se kaise karein, cheekh kar nahi.

dialogue.ar: أَوَّلُ شَرْطٍ في المُحاوَرَةِ النّاجِحَةِ هُوَ السَّماعُ الكامِلُ: تَسْمَعُ مُحاوِرَكَ حَتّى يُنْهِيَ كَلامَهُ ثُمَّ تُجيب.
dialogue.tr: awwalu sharṭin fī l-muḥāwarati n-nājiḥati huwa s-samāʿu l-kāmil: tasmaʿu muḥāwiraka ḥattā yunhiya kalāmahu thumma tujīb.
dialogue.en: The first condition of a successful dialogue is full listening: you hear your partner until he finishes his words, then you answer.
dialogue.ur: Kaamyab guftagu ki pehli shart poori tarah sunna hai: aap apne saathi ko us waqt tak sunte hain jab tak woh baat khatam na kare, phir jawab dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالشَّرْطُ الثّاني أَنْ تُقَدِّمَ الحُجَجَ وَالبَراهينَ، لا أَنْ تَكْتَفِيَ بِقَوْلِكَ: «أَنا أَعْلَمُ».
dialogue.tr: wa sh-sharṭu th-thānī an tuqaddima l-ḥujaja wa l-barāhīn, lā an taktafiya bi-qawlik: «anā aʿlam.»
dialogue.en: The second condition is that you give arguments and proofs, not be satisfied with saying: «I know.»
dialogue.ur: Doosri shart yeh hai ke aap hujjatein aur daleelein pesh karein, sirf «main jaanta hoon» kehna kaafi na samjhein.

dialogue.ar: وَابْتَعِدْ عَنِ المِراءِ وَالجَدَلِ الَّذي لا فائِدَةَ فيهِ، فَإِنَّ هَدَفَكَ الإِقْناعُ لا الغَلَبَة.
dialogue.tr: wa btaʿid ʿani l-mirāʾi wa l-jadali l-dhī lā fāʾidata fīh, fa-inna hadafaka l-iqnāʿu lā l-ghalaba.
dialogue.en: And keep away from quarrelling and argument that has no benefit, for your goal is persuasion, not victory.
dialogue.ur: Aur be-faida jhagde aur bahes se door rahein, kyunke aap ka maqsad qayal karna hai, jeetna nahi.

dialogue.ar: وَاجْعَلِ الحَقَّ غايَتَكَ؛ فَإِذا ظَهَرَ لَكَ أَنَّ مُحاوِرَكَ عَلى صَوابٍ فَاقْبَلْ ذٰلِكَ بِصَدْرٍ رَحْب.
dialogue.tr: wa jʿali l-ḥaqqa ghāyatak; fa-idhā ẓahara laka anna muḥāwiraka ʿalā ṣawābin fa-qbal dhālika bi-ṣadrin raḥb.
dialogue.en: Make the truth your goal; if it becomes clear to you that your partner is right, accept that with an open heart.
dialogue.ur: Haq ko apna maqsad banayein; agar aap par zahir ho jaye ke saathi theek hai to khule dil se maan lein.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ آدابِ الدَّعْوَةِ وَالحِوارِ قَوْلُهُ تَعالى: ﴿ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ  وَجَادِلْهُم بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ﴾.
dialogue.tr: wa min ʾādābi d-daʿwati wa l-ḥiūri qawluhu taʿālā: «dʿu ilā sabīli rabbika bi-l-ḥikmati wa l-mawʿiẓati l-ḥasanati wa jādilhum bi-l-tī hiya aḥsan.»
dialogue.en: Among the manners of calling and dialogue is His saying: «Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good advice, and argue with them in the best way.»
dialogue.ur: Dawat aur guftagu ke adab mein Allah ka farman hai: «Apne Rab ke raste ki taraf hikmat aur achhi nasihat se bulao aur un se behtareen tareeqe se bahes karo.»

dialogue.ar: وَفي الخِتامِ: الِاحْتِرامُ المُتَبادَلُ، وَتَقَبُّلُ النَّقْدِ، وَتَرْكُ التَّعَصُّبِ لِلرَّأْيِ، كُلُّها أَخْلاقُ المُتَحاوِرِ الكَريم.
dialogue.tr: wa fī l-khitām: al-ḥtirāmu l-mutabādal, wa taqabbulu n-naqd, wa tarku t-taʿaṣṣubi li-r-raʾy, kulluhā akhlāqu l-mutaḥāwiri l-karīm.
dialogue.en: In conclusion: mutual respect, accepting criticism and leaving fanaticism for one's opinion are all the manners of a noble discussant.
dialogue.ur: Aakhir mein: aapas ka ehtiram, tanqeed qubool karna aur apni raay par zid chhorna, yeh sab shareef muhawir ke akhlaq hain.

intro.en: A «صِفَة مُشَبَّهَة» describes a lasting quality of someone, like «فَرِح» (happy), «شُجاع» (brave) or «عَطْشان» (thirsty). It is built from a verb and comes in set patterns such as فَعِل، أَفْعَل، فَعْلان، فَعيل، فُعال، فَعَل and فَعْل.
intro.ur: «صِفَة مُشَبَّهَة» kisi ki pukhta khoobi ya halat batati hai, jaise «فَرِح» (khush)، «شُجاع» (bahadur)، «عَطْشان» (pyasa). Yeh fe'l se banti hai aur muqarrar wazan par aati hai jaise فَعِل، أَفْعَل، فَعْلان، فَعيل، فُعال، فَعَل aur فَعْل.
intro.ar: الصِّفَةُ المُشَبَّهَةُ تَصِفُ صِفَةً ثابِتَةً في الشَّخْصِ مِثْلَ «فَرِح» وَ«شُجاع» وَ«عَطْشان». تُصاغُ مِنَ الفِعْلِ عَلى أَوْزانٍ مِنْها فَعِل، أَفْعَل، فَعْلان، فَعيل، فُعال، فَعَل، فَعْل.

dialogue.ar: فَرِحَتِ الطِّفْلَةُ بِالهَدِيَّةِ، فَهِيَ فَرِحَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: fa-riḥati ṭ-ṭiflatu bi-l-hadiyyat, fa-hiya fa-riḥat.
dialogue.en: The little girl was glad with the gift, so she is glad.
dialogue.ur: Bachi tohfe se khush hui, to woh khush hai.

dialogue.ar: ضَجِرَ الطُّلّابُ مِنْ طولِ الدَّرْسِ، فَهُمْ ضَجِرونَ.
dialogue.tr: ḍajira ṭ-ṭullābu min ṭūli d-dars, fahum ḍajirūn.
dialogue.en: The students got fed up with the long lesson, so they are fed up.
dialogue.ur: Talba lambay sabaq se tang aa gaye, to woh bezaar hain.

dialogue.ar: عَوِرَ التّاجِرُ بَعْدَ الحادِثِ، فَصارَ أَعْوَرَ.
dialogue.tr: ʿawira t-tājiru baʿda l-ḥādith, fa-ṣāra aʿwar.
dialogue.en: The merchant lost an eye after the accident, so he became one-eyed.
dialogue.ur: Taajir haadse ke baad ek aankh kho baitha, to woh kana ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: شَهِبَ شَعْرُ الجَدِّ مَعَ السِّنينَ، فَهُوَ أَشْهَبُ الشَّعْرِ.
dialogue.tr: shahiba shaʿru l-jaddi maʿa s-sinīn, fa-huwa ashhabu sh-shaʿr.
dialogue.en: The grandfather's hair turned grey with the years, so his hair is grey.
dialogue.ur: Saalon ke saath dada ke baal sufaid-khaakistari ho gaye, to woh khaakistari baalon wala hai.

dialogue.ar: عَطِشَ المُسافِرُ في الصَّحْراءِ، فَهُوَ عَطْشانُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿaṭisha l-musāfiru fī ṣ-ṣaḥrāʾ, fa-huwa ʿaṭshān.
dialogue.en: The traveller became thirsty in the desert, so he is thirsty.
dialogue.ur: Musafir registan mein pyasa ho gaya, to woh pyasa hai.

dialogue.ar: رَوِيَتِ الأَرْضُ بَعْدَ المَطَرِ، فَهِيَ رَيّا.
dialogue.tr: rawiyati l-arḍu baʿda l-maṭar, fa-hiya rayyā.
dialogue.en: The land was watered after the rain, so it is well-watered.
dialogue.ur: Baarish ke baad zameen sairaab ho gayi, to woh sairaab hai.

dialogue.ar: ظَرُفَتِ الفَتاةُ في كَلامِها، فَهِيَ ظَريفَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ẓarufati l-fatātu fī kalāmihā, fa-hiya ẓarīfat.
dialogue.en: The girl became charming in her speech, so she is charming.
dialogue.ur: Ladki apni baaton mein dilkash ho gayi, to woh dilkash hai.

dialogue.ar: صَعُبَ الِامْتِحانُ هٰذَا العامَ، فَهُوَ صَعْبٌ.
dialogue.tr: ṣaʿuba l-mtiḥānu hādhā l-ʿām, fa-huwa ṣaʿb.
dialogue.en: The exam became hard this year, so it is hard.
dialogue.ur: Is saal imtihan mushkil ho gaya, to woh mushkil hai.

dialogue.ar: جَبُنَ الحَرَسِيُّ لَمّا سَمِعَ الصَّوْتَ، فَهُوَ جَبانٌ.
dialogue.tr: jabuna l-ḥarasiyyu lammā samiʿa ṣ-ṣawt, fa-huwa jabān.
dialogue.en: The guard lost his nerve when he heard the noise, so he is a coward.
dialogue.ur: Pehredar khatre ke waqt darpok nikla, to woh buzdil hai.

dialogue.ar: شَجُعَ الجُنْدِيُّ أَمامَ العَدُوِّ، فَهُوَ شُجاعٌ.
dialogue.tr: shajuʿa l-jundiyyu amāma l-ʿaduww, fa-huwa shujāʿ.
dialogue.en: The soldier became brave before the enemy, so he is brave.
dialogue.ur: Sipahi dushman ke samne bahadur nikla, to woh bahadur hai.

dialogue.ar: حَسُنَ الطَّقْسُ في الرَّبيعِ، فَهُوَ حَسَنٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḥasuna ṭ-ṭaqsu fī r-rabīʿ, fa-huwa ḥasan.
dialogue.en: The weather became fine in spring, so it is fine.
dialogue.ur: Bahaar mein mausam achha ho gaya, to woh achha hai.

dialogue.ar: حَلُوَ الشّايُ بَعْدَ السُّكَّرِ، فَهُوَ حُلْوٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaluwa sh-shāyu baʿda s-sukkar, fa-huwa ḥulw.
dialogue.en: The tea became sweet after the sugar, so it is sweet.
dialogue.ur: Cheeni dalne ke baad chai meethi ho gayi, to woh meethi hai.

title.ar: القِراءَةُ المُوَسَّعَة: مِنْ سيرَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
title.en: Extended reading: From the life of the Prophet ﷺ
title.ur: Wasee qirat: Nabi ﷺ ki seerat se

intro.en: This is a summary of the Prophet's life ﷺ in our own words: the start of revelation, the Night Journey, the pledges at al-'Aqaba, the Hijra to Madina, the main battles and treaty, the conquest of Makka, and his passing. We tell only well-known facts and add no rulings. Then there are comprehension exercises.
intro.ur: Yeh Nabi ﷺ ki seerat ka khulasa hai apne alfaz mein: wahi ka aaghaz, Isra o Mi'raj, Aqaba ki baiaten, Madina ki hijrat, ahem ghazwaat aur sulh, Fatah-e-Makkah aur aap ﷺ ki wafaat. Sirf mashhoor haqaiq bayan hue hain aur koi hukm nahi barhaya gaya. Phir samajh ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: هٰذا مُلَخَّصٌ لِسيرَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِعِبارَتِنا: بِدايَةُ الوَحْيِ، وَالإِسْراءُ وَالمِعْراجُ، وَبَيْعَةُ العَقَبَةِ، وَالهِجْرَةُ إِلَى المَدينَةِ، وَأَهَمُّ الغَزَواتِ وَالصُّلْحِ، وَفَتْحُ مَكَّةَ، وَوَفاتُهُ ﷺ. نَذْكُرُ الوَقائِعَ المَشْهورَةَ فَقَط وَلا نَزيدُ حُكْماً. ثُمَّ تَدْريباتٌ لِلْفَهْم.

dialogue.ar: تَبْدَأُ قِصَّةُ الرِّسالَةِ في غارِ حِراءَ، حَيْثُ كانَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ يَخْلو بِنَفْسِهِ لِلتَّفْكير.
dialogue.tr: tabdaʾu qiṣṣatu r-risālati fī ghāri ḥirāʾ, ḥaythu kāna muḥammadun ﷺ yakhlū bi-nafsihi li-t-tafkīr.
dialogue.en: The story of the message begins in the Cave of Hira, where Muhammad ﷺ used to be alone with himself to reflect.
dialogue.ur: Paigham ki kahani Ghaar-e-Hira se shuru hoti hai, jahan Muhammad ﷺ tanhai mein ghaur-o-fikr kiya karte the.

dialogue.ar: وَفي لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ لَيالي رَمَضانَ نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الوَحْيُ، فَكانَتْ تِلْكَ بِدايَةَ المَبْعَث.
dialogue.tr: wa fī laylatin min layālī ramaḍāna nazala ʿalayhi l-waḥy, fa-kānat tilka bi-dāyata l-mabʿath.
dialogue.en: On a night of Ramadan the revelation came down to him, and that was the beginning of his mission.
dialogue.ur: Ramazan ki ek raat un par wahi nazil hui, aur yeh bi'sat ka aaghaz tha.

dialogue.ar: فَآمَنَتْ بِهِ زَوْجَتُهُ خَديجَةُ وَصاحِبُهُ أَبو بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُما.
dialogue.tr: fa-ʾāmanat bihi zawjatuhu khadījatu wa ṣāḥibuhu abū bakrin raḍiya llāhu ʿanhumā.
dialogue.en: His wife Khadija and his companion Abu Bakr believed in him, may Allah be pleased with them both.
dialogue.ur: Un ki biwi Khadija aur un ke saathi Abu Bakr un par imaan laye, Allah un dono se raazi ho.

dialogue.ar: وَظَلَّتِ الدَّعْوَةُ سِرِّيَّةً في بِدايَتِها، ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ اللهُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِها، فَغَضِبَ المُشْرِكونَ وَآذَوُا المُسْلِمين.
dialogue.tr: wa ẓallati d-daʿwatu sirriyyatan fī bi-dāyatihā, thumma amarahu llāhu an yajhara bihā, fa-ghaḍiba l-mushrikūna wa ʾādhawu l-muslimīn.
dialogue.en: The call stayed secret at first, then Allah ordered him to proclaim it, so the polytheists became angry and harmed the Muslims.
dialogue.ur: Dawat shuru mein posheedah rahi, phir Allah ne hukm diya ke ailaniya karein, to mushrikeen naraaz hue aur musalmanon ko satane lage.

dialogue.ar: وَفي تِلْكَ السَّنَواتِ الصَّعْبَةِ أَكْرَمَهُ اللهُ بِالإِسْراءِ وَالمِعْراج، فَأُسْرِيَ بِهِ إِلَى المَسْجِدِ الأَقْصى ثُمَّ عُرِجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّماء.
dialogue.tr: wa fī tilka s-sanawāti ṣ-ṣaʿbati akramahu llāhu bi-l-isrāʾi wa l-miʿrāj, fa-usriya bihi ilā l-masjidi l-aqṣā thumma ʿurija bihi ilā s-samāʾ.
dialogue.en: In those hard years Allah honoured him with the Night Journey and the Ascension: he was taken by night to the Aqsa Mosque, then taken up to the heavens.
dialogue.ur: In mushkil saalon mein Allah ne unhein Isra o Mi'raj se nawaza: raat ko Masjid-e-Aqsa le jaya gaya phir aasmanon par le jaya gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ يَعْرِضُ الإِسْلامَ عَلَى القَبائِلِ في مَواسِمِ الحَجِّ، فَاسْتَجابَ لَهُ رِجالٌ مِنْ يَثْرِب.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna yaʿriḍu l-islāma ʿalā l-qabāʾili fī mawāsimi l-ḥajj, fa-stajāba lahu rijālun min yathrib.
dialogue.en: He used to present Islam to the tribes in the Hajj seasons, and men from Yathrib responded to him.
dialogue.ur: Woh hajj ke mausam mein qabilon ke samne Islam pesh karte the, to Yathrib ke kuch log un ki baat maan gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَعاهَدوهُ في العَقَبَةِ عَلى نُصْرَتِهِ، وَسُمِّيَ ذٰلِكَ العَهْدُ بَيْعَةَ العَقَبَة.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿāhadūhu fī l-ʿaqabati ʿalā nuṣratih, wa summiya dhālika l-ʿahdu bayʿata l-ʿaqaba.
dialogue.en: They pledged to him at al-'Aqaba to support him, and that pledge was called the Pledge of al-'Aqaba.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne Aqaba mein un ki madad ka ahd kiya, aur is ahd ko Baiat-e-Aqaba kaha gaya.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ أَذِنَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِأَصْحابِهِ بِالهِجْرَةِ إِلَى المَدينَةِ، فَخَرَجوا مُتَفَرِّقينَ وَتَرَكوا بُيوتَهُمْ وَأَمْوالَهُم.
dialogue.tr: thumma adhina n-nabiyyu ﷺ li-aṣḥābihi bi-l-hijrati ilā l-madīnat, fa-kharajū mutafarriqīna wa tarakū buīūtahum wa amūlahum.
dialogue.en: Then the Prophet ﷺ allowed his companions to migrate to Madina, so they left in small groups and left their houses and wealth.
dialogue.ur: Phir Nabi ﷺ ne sahaba ko Madina hijrat ki ijazat di, to woh alag alag nikle aur apne ghar aur maal chhor diye.

dialogue.ar: وَهاجَرَ هُوَ ﷺ مَعَ أَبي بَكْرٍ، فَاخْتَبَأَ في غارِ ثَوْرٍ ثَلاثَةَ أَيّامٍ، ثُمَّ تابَعا الطَّريقَ نَحْوَ المَدينَة.
dialogue.tr: wa hājara huwa ﷺ maʿa abī bakr, fa-khtabaʾa fī ghāri thawrin thalāthata ayyām, thumma tābaʿā ṭ-ṭarīqa naḥwa l-madīna.
dialogue.en: He ﷺ migrated with Abu Bakr; they hid in the Cave of Thawr for three days, then continued the road to Madina.
dialogue.ur: Aap ﷺ ne Abu Bakr ke saath hijrat ki; woh Ghaar-e-Thawr mein teen din chhupe rahe, phir Madina ki taraf safar jari rakha.

dialogue.ar: وَفي الطَّريقِ نَزَلَ في قُباءَ وَأَسَّسَ مَسْجِدَها، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ المَدينَةَ وَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ أَهْلُها بِالفَرَح.
dialogue.tr: wa fī ṭ-ṭarīqi nazala fī qubāʾa wa assasa masjidahā, thumma dakhala l-madīnata wa staqbalahu ahluhā bi-l-faraḥ.
dialogue.en: On the way he stopped at Quba and founded its mosque, then entered Madina and its people received him with joy.
dialogue.ur: Raaste mein Quba mein ruke aur wahan masjid ki bunyad rakhi, phir Madina mein dakhil hue aur logon ne khushi se istiqbal kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَسُمِّيَ أَهْلُ المَدينَةِ الَّذينَ آوَوْهُ وَنَصَروهُ الأَنْصارَ، وَسُمِّيَ مَنْ جاءَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ المُهاجِرين.
dialogue.tr: wa summiya ahlu l-madīnati l-dhīna ʾāwawhu wa naṣarūhu l-anṣār, wa summiya man jāʾa min makkata l-muhājirīn.
dialogue.en: The people of Madina who sheltered and supported him were called the Ansar, and those who came from Makka were called the Muhajirun.
dialogue.ur: Madina ke jin logon ne unhein panah di aur madad ki unhein Ansar kaha gaya, aur jo Makkah se aaye unhein Muhajirin.

dialogue.ar: وَبَنى في المَدينَةِ المَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ، وَجَعَلَ المُسْلِمينَ إِخْوَةً مُتَحابّين.
dialogue.tr: wa banā fī l-madīnati l-masjida n-nabawiyy, wa jaʿala l-muslimīna ikhwatan mutaḥābbīn.
dialogue.en: In Madina he built the Prophet's Mosque and made the Muslims brothers who loved one another.
dialogue.ur: Madina mein Masjid-e-Nabawi banayi aur musalmanon ko aapas mein mohabbat karne wale bhai bana diya.

dialogue.ar: وَفي السَّنَةِ الثّانِيَةِ مِنَ الهِجْرَةِ كانَتْ غَزْوَةُ بَدْرٍ، وَقَدْ نَصَرَ اللهُ فيها المُسْلِمينَ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī s-sanati th-thāniyati mina l-hijrati kānat ghazwatu badr, wa qad naṣara llāhu fīhā l-muslimīn.
dialogue.en: In the second year of the Hijra came the Battle of Badr, and Allah gave the Muslims victory in it.
dialogue.ur: Hijrat ke doosre saal Ghazwa-e-Badr hua, aur Allah ne us mein musalmanon ko fatah di.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ سَنَةٍ كانَتْ غَزْوَةُ أُحُدٍ عِنْدَ الجَبَلِ الَّذي يَحْمِلُ اسْمَها شَمالَ المَدينَة.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda sanatin kānat ghazwatu uḥudin ʿinda l-jabali l-dhī yaḥmilu smahā shamāla l-madīna.
dialogue.en: A year later came the Battle of Uhud, near the mountain that bears its name, north of Madina.
dialogue.ur: Ek saal baad Ghazwa-e-Uhud hua, us pahaad ke paas jis ka yeh naam hai, Madina ke shumal mein.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا اجْتَمَعَتِ القَبائِلُ لِحِصارِ المَدينَةِ حَفَرَ المُسْلِمونَ الخَنْدَقَ بِاقْتِراحِ سَلْمانَ الفارِسِيّ.
dialogue.tr: wa lammā jtamaʿati l-qabāʾilu li-ḥiṣāri l-madīnati ḥafara l-muslimūna l-khandaqa bi-qtirāḥi salmāna l-fārisiyy.
dialogue.en: When the tribes gathered to besiege Madina, the Muslims dug the trench on the suggestion of Salman al-Farisi.
dialogue.ur: Jab qabile Madina ka muhasira karne jama hue to musalmanon ne Salman Farsi ke mashware se khandaq khodi.

dialogue.ar: وَخَرَجَ ﷺ في السَّنَةِ السّادِسَةِ يُريدُ العُمْرَةَ، فَمَنَعَتْهُ قُرَيْشٌ، وَانْتَهى الأَمْرُ بِصُلْحِ الحُدَيْبِيَة.
dialogue.tr: wa kharaja ﷺ fī s-sanati s-sādisati yurīdu l-ʿumrat, fa-manaʿathu quraysh, wa ntahā l-amru bi-ṣulḥi l-ḥudaybiya.
dialogue.en: In the sixth year he ﷺ set out wanting to perform 'Umra, but Quraysh prevented him, and it ended with the Treaty of al-Hudaybiya.
dialogue.ur: Chhathe saal aap ﷺ umra ke irade se nikle, Quraish ne roka, aur baat Sulh-e-Hudaibiya par khatam hui.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتْ تِلْكَ المُعاهَدَةُ هُدْنَةً بَيْنَ الطَّرَفَيْنِ لِمُدَّةٍ طَويلَة.
dialogue.tr: wa kānat tilka l-muʿāhadatu hudnatan bayna ṭ-ṭarafayni li-muddatin ṭawīla.
dialogue.en: That agreement was a truce between the two sides for a long period.
dialogue.ur: Yeh muahida donon taraf ke darmiyan ek lambi muddat ke liye sulh tha.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ جاءَ الفَتْحُ في السَّنَةِ الثّامِنَةِ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مَكَّةَ وَعَفا عَنْ أَهْلِها.
dialogue.tr: thumma jāʾa l-fatḥu fī s-sanati th-thāminat, fa-dakhala n-nabiyyu ﷺ makkata wa ʿafā ʿan ahlihā.
dialogue.en: Then came the Conquest in the eighth year; the Prophet ﷺ entered Makka and forgave its people.
dialogue.ur: Phir aathwen saal Fatah-e-Makkah hui; Nabi ﷺ Makkah mein dakhil hue aur wahan ke logon ko maaf kar diya.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ حَجَّ حَجَّةَ الوَداعِ وَوَدَّعَ المُسْلِمينَ، وَتُوُفِّيَ ﷺ في المَدينَةِ في السَّنَةِ الحادِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ مِنَ الهِجْرَة.
dialogue.tr: thumma ḥajja ḥajjata l-wadāʿi wa waddaʿa l-muslimīn, wa tuwuffiya ﷺ fī l-madīnati fī s-sanati l-ḥādiyata ʿashrata mina l-hijra.
dialogue.en: Then he performed the Farewell Hajj and bade the Muslims farewell, and he ﷺ passed away in Madina in the eleventh year of the Hijra.
dialogue.ur: Phir aap ne Hajjatul Wida ada kiya aur musalmanon ko alvida kaha, aur gyarahwen saal-e-hijri mein Madina mein aap ﷺ ka inteqal hua.

q.en: In which month did Jibril bring the first revelation, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq Jibreel pehli wahi kis mahine mein laye?
q.ar: في أَيِّ شَهْرٍ نَزَلَ جِبْريلُ بِالوَحْيِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Who accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijra?
q.ur: Hijrat mein Nabi ﷺ ke saath kaun tha?
q.ar: مَنْ رافَقَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ في الهِجْرَةِ؟

q.en: Where did the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr hide for three days?
q.ur: Nabi ﷺ aur Abu Bakr teen din kahan chhupe?
q.ar: أَيْنَ اخْتَبَأَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَبو بَكْرٍ ثَلاثَةَ أَيّامٍ؟

q.en: What were the Madinans who helped the Prophet ﷺ called?
q.ur: Madina ke madad karne walon ko kya kehte the?
q.ar: ماذا سُمِّيَ أَهْلُ المَدينَةِ الَّذينَ نَصَروا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ؟

q.en: What did the Muslims dig to protect Madina in the Battle of the Confederates?
q.ur: Ghazwa-e-Ahzab mein Madina ki hifazat ke liye musalmanon ne kya khoda?
q.ar: ماذا حَفَرَ المُسْلِمونَ لِحِمايَةِ المَدينَةِ في غَزْوَةِ الأَحْزابِ؟
